Project #2 Project Name: Synterein Duration: June 2024 to Till date Role: Team Member / Power Apps Developer Environment: Power Apps, Power Automate, SQL Server 2012, Power BI
Description: Synterein application is an inventory database and HSE request system in a Basic Steel Company. It enables SABIC employees to raise and track protection equipment requests. The system includes workflows for approvals from department heads and Safety teams, along with reminders for pending requests.
Responsibilities: • Involved in complete application development life cycle including requirements gathering, analysis, design, development, testing, and deployment • Built Canvas Apps for request submissions, approvals, and tracking at department level • Automated approval workflows using Power Automate • Connected CRM data with Power Apps for real-time updates • Designed and developed custom workflows and visual web parts • Created role-based security (RLS) to control access to reports and datasets • Developed Event Receivers and Timer Jobs
PROJECT EXPERIENCE
Project #1 Project Name: PreStone Products
Duration: Jan 2023 to May 2024 Role: Team Member / Power Apps Developer Environment: Power Apps, Power Automate, Dynamics 365 CRM, Power Pages
Description: PreStone Products is a web-based business software suite for staffing and recruiting companies, providing integrated email, applicant tracking, CRM, job management, billing, reporting, and employee management.
Responsibilities: ➢ Involved in gathering and understanding requirements ➢ Built and customized Canvas Apps for different business needs ➢ Created Sites, Site Collections, Document and Form Libraries, and imported existing data ➢ Used Copilot to build app layouts and automate workflows with natural language prompts ➢ Built and deployed Power Apps integrated with Azure Logic Apps for advanced workflow automation ➢ Utilized Azure API Management to connect Power Apps with external APIs and services ➢ Leveraged Azure Functions to extend Power Apps capabilities with serverless computing ➢ Designed and developed Model-Driven Apps using Dataverse and Dynamics 365 ➢ Maintained and updated customer and candidate records within the CRM
